step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a mobile app user calling Qonto's banking card management web service via API Gateway. API Gateway triggers AWS Lambda. Lambda retrieves encrypted secrets and certificates from Systems Manager, which uses KMS for encryption. Lambda authenticates user requests and forwards them to the Mastercard network, receiving response verification back. For application logging, Lambda routes outbound traffic through an internet proxy setup (ELB, EC2, NAT Gateway) before sending logs to Sentry.
